evals.prompt: Recommend a Vite starter template for a Vue 3 + TypeScript project.
evals.expected_output: Routes to Get Started / Templates / Vue 3 in awesome-vite and surfaces the official Vue 3 + TS starter with provenance.
expectations: Routes to Get Started / Templates / Vue 3

evals.prompt: I need a Vite plugin to turn my app into an installable PWA.
evals.expected_output: Routes to Plugins / Framework-agnostic and recommends vite-plugin-pwa with provenance.

evals.prompt: Migrate my Create React App project to Vite — is there a tool for that?
evals.expected_output: Routes to Migrations / React and recommends Viject, the only CRA-to-Vite entry, with provenance.

evals.prompt: I want SSR with Vite for a Vue app — which library should I use?
evals.expected_output: Routes to SSR / Libraries and recommends Vike (or vite-ssr-boost / Vinxi) with provenance.
expectations: Recommends Vike or a comparable SSR library

evals.prompt: Find a Vite + Laravel backend integration.
evals.expected_output: Routes to Integrations with Backends / Laravel and surfaces the matching entry with provenance.
expectations: Routes to Integrations with Backends / Laravel

evals.prompt: Show me a Vite-based SSG / docs site for inspiration.
evals.expected_output: Routes to Projects Using Vite.js / Open Source and recommends VitePress (and/or Slidev / Astro) with provenance.
expectations: Routes to Projects Using Vite.js / Open Source

evals.prompt: I need a Vite plugin for SVG sprites in my design system.
evals.expected_output: Routes to Plugins / Framework-agnostic and recommends an SVG-sprite plugin with provenance.

evals.prompt: Is there a Vite plugin for module federation / micro-frontends?
evals.expected_output: Routes to Plugins / Framework-agnostic and recommends a module-federation plugin with provenance.

evals.prompt: Find a Vite plugin that optimizes images at build time.
evals.expected_output: Routes to Plugins / Framework-agnostic and recommends an image-optimization plugin (e.g. vite-plugin-imagemin) with provenance.

evals.prompt: Which Vite scaffolder should I use — npm create vite or one of the framework-specific ones?
evals.expected_output: Routes to Get Started / Get Started and lists the 8 official scaffolders with provenance.
expectations: Routes to Get Started / Get Started
